title: LiteSpeed vs Apache vs Nginx: caching a tired WooCommerce store
lede: A six-year-old WooCommerce store, 14k products, one VPS. We swapped the reverse cache three times and watched what actually moved the TTFB needle.
hero_alt: Overhead still life on bone linen: stacked benchmark cards, vhost printout, graph-paper sheet, brass CACHE plate, red wax seal.
